title: 第2课 · 我每天六点起床
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 2 — 我每天六点起床 · I get up at six every day

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在运动场 — On the playground

items.zh: A：你很少生病，是不是喜欢运动？
items.py: A: Nǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng, shì bu shì xǐhuan yùndòng?
items.en: A: You seldom get sick. You like sports, don't you?

items.zh: B：是啊，我每天早上都要出去跑步。
items.py: B: Shì a, wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang dōu yào chūqu pǎo bù.
items.en: B: Yes. I go out for a run every morning.

items.py: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
items.en: A: What time do you get up?

items.py: B: Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.
items.en: B: I get up at six every day.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在医院 — In the hospital

items.zh: A：吃药了吗？现在身体怎么样？
items.py: A: Chī yào le ma? Xiànzài shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?
items.en: A: Did you take your medicine? How do you feel now?

items.py: B: Chī le. Xiànzài hǎo duō le.
items.en: B: Yes. I feel much better now.

items.py: A: Shénme shíhou néng chū yuàn?
items.en: A: When can you leave the hospital?

items.py: B: Yīshēng shuō xià ge xīngqī.
items.en: B: Next week, the doctor says.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在操场 — On the sports ground

items.py: A: Dàwèi jīnnián duō dà?
B: Èrshí duō suì.
A: Tā duō gāo?
B: Yì mǐ bā jǐ.
A: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào zhème duō a?
items.en: A: How come you know so much about him?

items.py: B: Tā shì wǒ tóngxué.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在房间 — In the room

items.zh: A：张老师星期六也不休息啊？
items.py: A: Zhāng lǎoshī xīngqī liù yě bù xiūxi a?
items.en: A: Doesn't Teacher Zhang rest on Saturdays either?

items.zh: B：是啊，他这几天很忙，没有时间休息。
items.py: B: Shì a, tā zhè jǐ tiān hěn máng, méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
items.en: B: No. He's been very busy lately and has no time to rest.

items.py: A: Nà huì hěn lèi ba?
B: Tā měi tiān huílai dōu hěn lèi.
items.en: B: He comes home exhausted every day.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (用“是不是”的问句)

items.zh: 你很少生病，是不是喜欢运动？
items.py: Nǐ hěn shǎo shēng bìng, shì bu shì xǐhuan yùndòng?
items.en: You rarely get ill — you like sport, don't you?

items.py: Shì bu shì míngtiān bàba xiūxi?
items.en: Dad is off tomorrow, isn't he?

items.zh: 我们星期一去北京，是不是？
items.py: Wǒmen xīngqī yī qù Běijīng, shì bu shì?
items.en: We're going to Beijing on Monday, right?

items.zh: 山姆每年都去中国旅游。
items.py: Shānmǔ měi nián dōu qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
items.en: Sam travels to China every year.

items.zh: 你每个星期六都工作吗？
items.py: Nǐ měi ge xīngqī liù dōu gōngzuò ma?
Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.
items.en: I get up at six every day.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (疑问代词“多” + Adj)

items.py: Nǐ duō dà? — Wǒ shíliù suì.

items.zh: 王医生的儿子多高？——他儿子一米七。
items.py: Wáng yīshēng de érzi duō gāo? — Tā érzi yì mǐ qī.
items.en: How tall is Dr Wang's son? — 1.70 m.

items.py: Tā duō gāo? — Yì mǐ bā jǐ.
items.en: How tall is he? — Over 1.80 m.

items.py: Tā wèi shénme hěn shǎo shēng bìng?
items.en: Why does he rarely get ill?

items.py: Tā měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
items.en: What time does he get up every day?

items.py: Tā xiànzài shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?
Dàwèi jīnnián duō gāo? Duō dà?
items.en: How tall and how old is David?

items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī xīngqī liù xiūxi ma?
items.en: Does Teacher Zhang rest on Saturday?
